examples.text_en: The sudden power cut caused complete pandemonium.
examples.text_zh: 突然停电引起了一片混乱。

examples.text_en: There was pandemonium when the doors opened.
examples.text_zh: 大门打开时一片混乱。

examples.text_en: He would pander to the low ideas of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他会迎合那群人低俗的想法。

examples.text_en: Do not pander to them just to win the vote.
examples.text_zh: 别为了赢得选票就去迎合他们。

examples.text_en: He wrote a panegyric about the late king.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一篇颂扬已故国王的颂词。

examples.text_en: Her speech was a panegyric to hard work.
examples.text_zh: 她的演讲是对勤奋工作的赞颂。

examples.text_en: She felt a sudden pang of regret.
examples.text_zh: 她突然感到一阵悔意。

examples.text_en: Hunger pangs kept him awake at night.
examples.text_zh: 饥饿的剧痛让他夜里睡不着。

examples.text_en: From the hill we saw a wide panorama.
examples.text_zh: 从山上我们看到了广阔的景色。

examples.text_en: The book gives a panorama of modern history.
examples.text_zh: 这本书展现了现代史的全貌。

examples.text_en: The hotel room has a panoramic view.
examples.text_zh: 这间酒店客房能看到全景。

examples.text_en: We took a panoramic photo of the valley.
examples.text_zh: 我们拍了一张山谷的全景照片。

examples.text_en: The pantechnicon stopped outside the new house.
examples.text_zh: 家具搬运车停在了新房子外面。

examples.text_en: Two pantechnicons blocked the narrow street.
examples.text_zh: 两辆家具搬运车堵住了狭窄的街道。

examples.text_en: The temple served as a pantheon for many gods.
examples.text_zh: 这座神庙曾是供奉众神的地方。

examples.text_en: He joined the pantheon of great writers.
examples.text_zh: 他跻身伟大作家的行列。

examples.text_en: A black panther moved through the dark trees.
examples.text_zh: 一只黑豹穿过幽暗的树林。

examples.text_en: The panthers hunted quietly in the night.
examples.text_zh: 豹群在夜里悄悄地捕猎。

examples.text_en: The children loved the pantomime at the school.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们喜欢学校里的哑剧。

examples.text_en: He told the story in pantomime and no words.
examples.text_zh: 他用哑剧、不说一个字地讲了这个故事。

examples.text_en: Ancient scribes wrote on sheets of papyrus.
examples.text_zh: 古代的书吏在纸草上书写。

examples.text_en: The museum keeps several rolls of papyrus.
examples.text_zh: 博物馆保存着几卷纸草。

examples.text_en: The teacher told a parable about patience.
examples.text_zh: 老师讲了一个关于耐心的寓言。

examples.text_en: Each parable hides a simple moral lesson.
examples.text_zh: 每个寓言都藏着一个简单的道理。

examples.text_en: The ball followed a smooth parabola through the air.
examples.text_zh: 球在空中划出一道平滑的抛物线。

examples.text_en: She drew a parabola on the graph paper.
examples.text_zh: 她在方格纸上画了一条抛物线。

examples.text_en: The discovery changed the paradigm of physics.
examples.text_zh: 这一发现改变了物理学的范式。

examples.text_en: Her work offers a new paradigm for teaching.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作提供了新的教学范例。

examples.text_en: It is paradoxical that the poor man felt free.
examples.text_zh: 奇怪的是，这个穷人竟感到自由。

examples.text_en: His paradoxical words made us think for a time.
examples.text_zh: 他矛盾的话让我们思考了一阵。

examples.text_en: Paradoxically, the long road was the fast one.
examples.text_zh: 说来矛盾，这条长路反而是快的那条。

examples.text_en: He was paradoxically both good and bad.
examples.text_zh: 说来矛盾，他既好又坏。

examples.text_en: She was a paragon of good work in the school.
examples.text_zh: 她是学校里优秀工作的典范。

examples.text_en: They called him a paragon among the young men.
examples.text_zh: 他们称他为年轻人中的完人。

examples.text_en: There is a clear parallelism between the two plans.
examples.text_zh: 这两个计划之间有明显的相似之处。

examples.text_en: The parallelism of these two lines is easy to see.
examples.text_zh: 这两条线的平行很容易看出。

examples.text_en: A sudden stroke can paralyse one side of the body.
examples.text_zh: 突然中风可能使身体一侧瘫痪。

examples.text_en: Fear can paralyse a person before a speech.
examples.text_zh: 恐惧会让人在演讲前僵住。

examples.text_en: The accident left him with partial paralysis.
examples.text_zh: 那场事故使他留下了局部瘫痪。

examples.text_en: A sudden paralysis gripped the busy office.
examples.text_zh: 一片突如其来的瘫痪笼罩了繁忙的办公室。

examples.text_en: We must adjust several parameters in the model.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须调整模型中的几个参数。

examples.text_en: Cost is an important parameter in the design.
examples.text_zh: 成本是设计中的一个重要参数。

examples.text_en: The paramount gave the word to the group.
examples.text_zh: 最高当局向众人下了命令。

examples.text_en: They went to the paramount for a clear answer.
examples.text_zh: 他们去最高当局那里寻求明确的答复。

examples.text_en: His constant paranoia made friendship difficult.
examples.text_zh: 他持续的偏执让交友变得困难。

examples.text_en: The illness brought deep fear and paranoia.
examples.text_zh: 这场病带来了深深的恐惧和偏执。

examples.text_en: He put all his paraphernalia on the long table.
examples.text_zh: 他把全部随身用具放在长桌上。

examples.text_en: Her paraphernalia was full of paper and cards.
examples.text_zh: 她的随身用具里满是纸张和卡片。

examples.text_en: Please paraphrase this long line in simple words.
examples.text_zh: 请用简单的话改述这个长句。

examples.text_en: His paraphrase of the story was short and clear.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个故事的改写简短而清楚。

examples.text_en: She studies parapsychology at a large university.
examples.text_zh: 她在一所大型大学里研究心灵学。

examples.text_en: Parapsychology is not a common field for us.
examples.text_zh: 对我们来说，心灵学不是个常见的领域。

examples.text_en: This parasitic form lives on the body.
examples.text_zh: 这种寄生形态附在身体上。

examples.text_en: They studied the parasitic life in the water.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了水中的寄生生物。

examples.text_en: He pared the apple with a small knife.
examples.text_zh: 他用小刀削了苹果。

examples.text_en: The company pared costs to survive the year.
examples.text_zh: 公司削减开支以度过这一年。

examples.text_en: She had a lot of parental support at school.
examples.text_zh: 她在学校里得到父母的大力支持。

examples.text_en: Parental care is important for young children.
examples.text_zh: 父母的关爱对幼儿很重要。

examples.text_en: There was parity between the two groups at last.
examples.text_zh: 两个团体之间终于达到了均等。

examples.text_en: They wanted parity in pay for the same work.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望同样的工作能得到同等的报酬。

examples.text_en: He wore a thick parka in the snow.
examples.text_zh: 下雪时他穿着一件厚厚的派克大衣。

examples.text_en: Her parka kept her warm all winter.
examples.text_zh: 她的派克大衣让她整个冬天都很暖和。

examples.text_en: In common parlance, this is called a hard day.
examples.text_zh: 按通常的说法，这叫作难熬的一天。

examples.text_en: In legal parlance, the word has another sense.
examples.text_zh: 在法律用语里，这个词另有含义。

examples.text_en: The two sides held a parley at dawn.
examples.text_zh: 双方在黎明时举行了一次会谈。

examples.text_en: They agreed to a parley before the battle.
examples.text_zh: 他们同意在战斗前进行一次谈判。

examples.text_en: The parliamentary group met on the first day.
examples.text_zh: 国会团体在第一天开了会。

examples.text_en: There was a long parliamentary talk that night.
examples.text_zh: 那天夜里有一场漫长的议会发言。

examples.text_en: The company is in a parlous state.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司处于危险的境地。

examples.text_en: They faced a parlous journey through the mountains.
examples.text_zh: 他们面临一段穿越群山的危险旅程。

examples.text_en: The film is a clever parody of horror movies.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影是对恐怖片的巧妙模仿。

examples.text_en: He wrote a parody of a famous poem.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一首模仿名诗的打油诗。

examples.text_en: A paroxysm of pain came in the night.
examples.text_zh: 一阵剧痛在夜里袭来。

examples.text_en: He had a paroxysm of feeling and could not talk.
examples.text_zh: 他情绪一阵爆发，说不出话来。

examples.text_en: The hall has a beautiful parquet floor.
examples.text_zh: 大厅铺着漂亮的镶木地板。

examples.text_en: They danced across the polished parquet.
examples.text_zh: 他们在打磨过的镶木地板上跳舞。

examples.text_en: He used his hand to parry the strong attack.
examples.text_zh: 他用手挡开了那记猛击。

examples.text_en: She tried to parry every question from the group.
examples.text_zh: 她试图回避众人提出的每个问题。

examples.text_en: His parsimony made life hard for the family.
examples.text_zh: 他的吝啬让一家人的日子很难过。

examples.text_en: They called his parsimony a kind of loss.
examples.text_zh: 他们把他的吝啬说成一种损失。

examples.text_en: She has a part-time job in the city.
examples.text_zh: 她在城里有一份兼职工作。

examples.text_en: He works part-time and studies at the same time.
examples.text_zh: 他一边做兼职，一边上学。

examples.text_en: He showed partiality to one young boy.
examples.text_zh: 他对一个小男孩表现出了偏心。

examples.text_en: They did not like his partiality in this case.
examples.text_zh: 他们不喜欢他在这个案子里的偏颇。

examples.text_en: The bridge was partially closed for repairs.
examples.text_zh: 这座桥因维修而部分封闭。

examples.text_en: She was only partially satisfied with the result.
examples.text_zh: 她对结果只感到部分满意。

examples.text_en: Every participant received a small gift.
examples.text_zh: 每位参加者都收到了一份小礼物。

examples.text_en: The participant shared his views with the group.
examples.text_zh: 参加者与小组分享了自己的看法。

examples.text_en: Please particularize your plan with clear steps.
examples.text_zh: 请用明确的步骤详细说明你的计划。

examples.text_en: She particularized each cost in the report.
examples.text_zh: 她在报告中逐项详细说明了每笔费用。

examples.text_en: The air was thick with fine particulate matter.
examples.text_zh: 空气中弥漫着细小的颗粒物。

examples.text_en: Filters trap particulates before they reach the room.
examples.text_zh: 过滤器在颗粒物进入房间前将其拦截。

examples.text_en: He remained a loyal partisan of the party.
examples.text_zh: 他始终是这个党派忠诚的拥护者。

examples.text_en: The partisans fought in the mountain forests.
examples.text_zh: 游击队员们在山林中作战。

examples.text_en: A thin partition divided the two small rooms.
examples.text_zh: 一道薄隔墙把两个小房间分隔开。

examples.text_en: They built a wooden partition across the hall.
examples.text_zh: 他们在厅里横着修了一道木隔断。

examples.text_en: The parturition took place in the small room.
examples.text_zh: 分娩在那个小房间里进行。

examples.text_en: She was ready for parturition after many months.
examples.text_zh: 过了许多个月，她准备好分娩了。

examples.text_en: A passerby saw the fire and called for help.
examples.text_zh: 一个过路人看见了火，便喊人帮忙。

examples.text_en: The passerby did not stop to talk to us.
examples.text_zh: 那个过路人没有停下来和我们说话。

examples.text_en: She is passionate about music and painting.
examples.text_zh: 她对音乐和绘画充满热情。

examples.text_en: They shared a passionate love of the sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们都对大海怀有热烈的爱。

examples.text_en: The artist used pastels to draw the sky.
examples.text_zh: 画家用粉蜡笔画了天空。

examples.text_en: A box of pastels lay on the desk.
examples.text_zh: 一盒粉蜡笔放在桌上。

examples.text_en: They pasteurize this food before it leaves here.
examples.text_zh: 这种食物在出厂前会被巴氏灭菌。

examples.text_en: We must pasteurize the water for the children.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须为孩子们把水做巴氏灭菌。

examples.text_en: The novel reads like a pastiche of many styles.
examples.text_zh: 这部小说读起来像多种风格的拼凑之作。

examples.text_en: His painting is a pastiche of famous works.
examples.text_zh: 他的画是名作的模仿拼贴。

examples.text_en: The poem describes a peaceful pastoral scene.
examples.text_zh: 这首诗描绘了一幅宁静的田园景象。

examples.text_en: She sang a gentle pastoral at the concert.
examples.text_zh: 她在音乐会上唱了一首柔和的牧歌。

examples.text_en: The company filed a patent for the device.
examples.text_zh: 公司为这个装置申请了专利。

examples.text_en: He holds several patents on small machines.
examples.text_zh: 他拥有好几项小型机器的专利。

examples.text_en: He had a strong paternal feeling for the boy.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个男孩有一种强烈的父爱。

examples.text_en: Her paternal home was far from this city.
examples.text_zh: 她父亲的家离这座城市很远。

examples.text_en: The question of paternity was never answered.
examples.text_zh: 父亲身份的问题始终没有得到回答。

examples.text_en: They tried to show his paternity in the case.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图在案子里证明他的父亲身份。

examples.text_en: The lost puppy looked sad and pathetic.
examples.text_zh: 那只走失的小狗看起来又伤心又可怜。

examples.text_en: His pathetic excuse made everyone laugh.
examples.text_zh: 他可怜巴巴的借口让大家笑了。

examples.text_en: A dangerous pathogen spread through the water.
examples.text_zh: 一种危险的病原体在水中传播。

examples.text_en: Doctors study how pathogens attack the body.
examples.text_zh: 医生研究病原体如何侵袭人体。

examples.text_en: He had a pathological need for the light.
examples.text_zh: 他对光有一种病态的需求。

examples.text_en: They called all his ways pathological.
examples.text_zh: 他们把他所有的做法都称为病态的。

examples.text_en: He studies pathology at a large university.
examples.text_zh: 他在一所大型大学里研究病理学。

examples.text_en: The pathology of this form is not clear.
examples.text_zh: 这种形态的病理还不清楚。

examples.text_en: The final scene was full of pathos.
examples.text_zh: 最后的场景充满了哀伤的情调。

examples.text_en: Her song carried a deep sense of pathos.
examples.text_zh: 她的歌里带着深深的悲悯。

examples.text_en: Exercise opens a pathway to better health.
examples.text_zh: 锻炼为更好的健康开辟了一条路径。

examples.text_en: The garden has a narrow stone pathway.
examples.text_zh: 花园里有一条狭窄的石径。

examples.text_en: A green patina covered the copper roof.
examples.text_zh: 铜屋顶上覆着一层绿色的锈。

examples.text_en: The table had a fine patina of age.
examples.text_zh: 这张桌子带着岁月留下的光泽。

examples.text_en: The patriarch led the family for many years.
examples.text_zh: 这位家长多年主持着家族事务。

examples.text_en: The village elders respected the wise patriarch.
examples.text_zh: 村里的长辈们敬重这位睿智的族长。

examples.text_en: They lived under a strict patriarchal system.
examples.text_zh: 他们生活在一个严格的父权制度下。

examples.text_en: The patriarchal family made all decisions together.
examples.text_zh: 这个父权家庭一起做出所有决定。

examples.text_en: The patrician owned several large country houses.
examples.text_zh: 这位贵族拥有好几座乡间大宅。

examples.text_en: A patrician family ruled the city for centuries.
examples.text_zh: 一个贵族家族统治了这座城市几个世纪。

examples.text_en: The play tells the story of a patricide.
examples.text_zh: 这出戏讲述了一桩杀父案。

examples.text_en: He was accused of patricide and brought to trial.
examples.text_zh: 他被指控杀父并被送上法庭。

examples.text_en: He wasted his family patrimony in a year.
examples.text_zh: 他一年之内就挥霍掉了家族的传家财产。

examples.text_en: The house was part of the family patrimony.
examples.text_zh: 这所房子是家族遗产的一部分。

examples.text_en: The patrol walked through the town all night.
examples.text_zh: 巡逻队整夜走遍全镇。

examples.text_en: They went out on patrol at the first light.
examples.text_zh: 天刚亮他们就出去巡逻了。

examples.text_en: The patroller walked along the dark city street.
examples.text_zh: 巡警沿着黑暗的城市街道走着。

examples.text_en: A patroller stopped us near the front door.
examples.text_zh: 一名巡警在前门附近拦住了我们。

examples.text_en: A wealthy patron paid for the new hall.
examples.text_zh: 一位富有的赞助人出资修建了新礼堂。

examples.text_en: The shop thanked its loyal patrons warmly.
examples.text_zh: 这家店热情地感谢了忠实的顾客。

examples.text_en: The school was under his patronage for years.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校在他的赞助下办了许多年。

examples.text_en: They did not like the patronage in his voice.
examples.text_zh: 他们不喜欢他语气里那种居高临下的态度。

examples.text_en: Please patronize this little place in town.
examples.text_zh: 请光顾我们镇上的这个小店。

examples.text_en: They tried to patronize him and he did not care.
examples.text_zh: 他们想对他摆出恩赐的态度，他却不在意。

examples.text_en: There was a paucity of food that long year.
examples.text_zh: 那漫长的一年里食物短缺。

examples.text_en: The paucity of help made the work very hard.
examples.text_zh: 人手缺乏让这项工作变得非常艰难。

examples.text_en: The paunchy man had a hard time at work.
examples.text_zh: 这个肚子大的男人工作时很吃力。

examples.text_en: He was paunchy and did not like it.
examples.text_zh: 他肚子很大，自己也不喜欢这样。

examples.text_en: The pauper asked for a warm meal.
examples.text_zh: 这个贫民想要一顿热饭。

examples.text_en: He died a pauper in a small room.
examples.text_zh: 他在一间小屋里贫困地死去。

examples.text_en: The cat licked its injured front paw.
examples.text_zh: 猫舔了舔受伤的前爪。

examples.text_en: The dog placed a muddy paw on me.
examples.text_zh: 狗把一只泥乎乎的爪子搭在我身上。

examples.text_en: He left his watch as a pawn.
examples.text_zh: 他把手表留下作抵押。

examples.text_en: Each pawn moves forward on the board.
examples.text_zh: 棋盘上每个兵都向前移动。

examples.text_en: The money is payable by the end of the week.
examples.text_zh: 这笔钱要在周末前付清。

examples.text_en: This amount is payable in two small parts.
examples.text_zh: 这笔款可以分两次小额支付。

examples.text_en: The long work had a big payoff in the end.
examples.text_zh: 长期的努力最终得到了丰厚的回报。

examples.text_en: They waited years for the payoff of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们为这个计划的回报等了许多年。

examples.text_en: A beautiful peacock walked across the green field.
examples.text_zh: 一只美丽的孔雀走过绿色的田野。

examples.text_en: He was a peacock and loved to show off.
examples.text_zh: 他爱炫耀，喜欢出风头。

examples.text_en: The boy looked peaky after the long night.
examples.text_zh: 熬过长夜后，那男孩显得很消瘦。

examples.text_en: His face was peaky in the morning light.
examples.text_zh: 晨光里他的脸色很憔悴。

examples.text_en: The peasant worked hard in the rice fields.
examples.text_zh: 这个农夫在稻田里辛勤劳作。

examples.text_en: A peasant moved to the city for work.
examples.text_zh: 一个农民搬到城市去谋生。

examples.text_en: They called it a peccadillo and left.
examples.text_zh: 他们称这只是个小过失，便离开了。

examples.text_en: A peccadillo from his past was not important.
examples.text_zh: 他过去的一个小过失并不重要。

examples.text_en: He tried to peculate money from the company.
examples.text_zh: 他试图从公司挪用钱款。

examples.text_en: They found a way to peculate the public money.
examples.text_zh: 他们找到办法侵吞公款。

examples.text_en: One peculiarity of his work is the long lines.
examples.text_zh: 他作品的一个特点是那些长句。

examples.text_en: She had a peculiarity about her food.
examples.text_zh: 她对吃的有些怪癖。

examples.text_en: They had pecuniary problems for many long years.
examples.text_zh: 他们多年来一直有金钱上的问题。

examples.text_en: His interest in the plan was pecuniary.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个计划的兴趣纯粹是金钱上的。

examples.text_en: The school used a new pedagogic form this year.
examples.text_zh: 学校今年采用了一种新的教学形式。

examples.text_en: Her pedagogic work was clear and very good.
examples.text_zh: 她的教学工作清楚而出色。

examples.text_en: They talked about pedagogical forms at the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他们在会上谈论了教学法的形式。

examples.text_en: This pedagogical book is for young parents.
examples.text_zh: 这本教学法的书是给年轻父母看的。

examples.text_en: The strict pedagogue demanded perfect attention.
examples.text_zh: 这位严厉的教师要求绝对的专注。

examples.text_en: A good pedagogue can inspire many students.
examples.text_zh: 一位好教师能激励许多学生。

examples.text_en: She studies pedagogy at a large university.
examples.text_zh: 她在一所大型大学里研究教育学。

examples.text_en: Pedagogy is an important part of this work.
examples.text_zh: 教育学是这项工作的重要部分。

examples.text_en: He pressed the brake pedal hard.
examples.text_zh: 他用力踩下刹车踏板。

examples.text_en: The gas pedal was stuck near the floor.
examples.text_zh: 油门踏板卡在贴近地板的位置。

examples.text_en: The pedant corrected every small mistake.
examples.text_zh: 那个书呆子纠正了每一个小错误。

examples.text_en: Nobody likes a pedant at a party.
examples.text_zh: 聚会上没人喜欢爱卖弄学问的人。

examples.text_en: He used to peddle fruit in the market.
examples.text_zh: 他过去在市场上沿街叫卖水果。

examples.text_en: They peddle cheap goods from a small cart.
examples.text_zh: 他们用小推车兜售便宜货。

examples.text_en: The statue stands on a tall stone pedestal.
examples.text_zh: 雕像立在一个高高的石基座上。

examples.text_en: She placed the vase on a wooden pedestal.
examples.text_zh: 她把花瓶放在一个木制基座上。

examples.text_en: She studies pediatrics at a large university.
examples.text_zh: 她在一所大型大学里研究小儿科。

examples.text_en: Pediatrics is a part of modern health work.
examples.text_zh: 小儿科是现代医疗工作的一部分。

examples.text_en: The pedlar sold ribbons from door to door.
examples.text_zh: 小贩挨家挨户地卖丝带。

examples.text_en: A pedlar offered us small wooden toys.
examples.text_zh: 一个小贩向我们兜售小木玩具。

examples.text_en: She peeked through the curtains at the street.
examples.text_zh: 她透过窗帘偷看街道。

examples.text_en: He peeked into the room and saw nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他偷看了一眼房间，什么也没看到。
